name: response-pipe
description: Format a work reply so you can return to the same chat, see the last confirmed milestone, and continue with the next plan item.

interface.shortDescription: See where work stopped and what to do next
interface.longDescription: Finish a reply with the last confirmed milestone, the next action, and a link to where it happens. Preserve the plan’s step IDs and show which actions depend on each other or can start together.
defaultPrompt: Show where we left off and which step to continue with in this chat.
Use this format at the end of every work reply in this chat.
